name: Kamaitachi-ppoi Yoru?
source:
One day, the Gensoukyou is suddenly encompassed by a storm.

A dead body is found.

Who will you discover as the culprit in this Toho character mystery ADV!

一具屍體被發現。

在這款東方角色推理ADV中，你會找出誰是兇手？
